_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Keys are model ids as sent in requests; a key also matches the same id with a us./global./eu. inference-profile prefix. Override or extend with CUA_MODEL_PRICES='{"model": {"input": .., "cachedInput": .., "cacheWrite": .., "output": ..}}'. Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens. cacheWrite falls back to the input price when omitted.

_sources.openai.gpt-5.6-sol: https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/08/bedrock-openai-gpt-56-sol-reduced-pricing/ (promotional price through at least 2026-11-21; 272K-context profile; 1M-context profile is $8 in / $30 out; cached input is a 90% discount)
_sources.gpt-6-*: OpenAI pricing page, standard tier, short context (2026-09-28); long context is double; FedRAMP endpoints add 10%
_sources.gpt-5.6-terra: OpenAI pricing page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing), standard tier, short context, up to 272K input tokens (2026-10-09); long context is $4 in / $0.40 cached / $5 cache write / $18 out
_sources.qwen3.8-27b: self-hosted on vLLM: no per-token cost
_sources.text-embedding-3-*: OpenAI pricing page (2026-10-05); the same price through OpenRouter under the openai/ prefix; embeddings have no output tokens
